data.name: Revolution 1.6-19
data.author: Thumblegudget, Bredroll, QuantX, NexusQuille, Dr-RazdalByte + Others
data.description:
The Revolution mod brings Radar enhancements, a more immersive fog-of-war for island captures and other features.
[b]Fixed a bug that would crash the game when trying to dock a ground unit to a full AI/player carrier[/b]
[b]Gamepad now fixed in loadout and control screen![/b]
v1.6 new features: [list] [*] pvp synchronised auto-launch [*] new 5 minute autosave feature! [*] Revamped Mule, can carry weapons, passengers and extra internal fuel. [*] Control screens can create markers and preset patrol paths. [*] Captain's extra aircraft display. [*] Multi-unit select in control screens (hold R and drag a box) [*] Turn off lights on selected-groups of units [*] Option to set aircraft altitude for all waypoints. [*] Excess aircraft payloads shown visually in loadout, Some units have hard max payloads for balance [*] 2x water speed as standard for all units, WLR can deploy AA missiles [*] Helm and Radar screens are HD, Helm HUD and VLS as standard. [*] QoL changes to the inventory screen map display/tooltips [/list]
v1.5: [list] [*] Improved UI for turret deployment by Dr-RazdalByte [*] TV missile shows minimap and distances to target and launcher and has compass marks [*] Turrets can now be moved around by ground vehicles pushing. [/list]
[list] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3098073689]v1.5 available here[/url] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3496283808]v1.4 available here[/url] [/list]
For full details on what the mod does, how you can contribute or request features see [url=https://cc2maps.com/revolution-mod/]https://cc2maps.com/revolution-mod/[/url]
The mod is based on UI Enhancer and Albatross AWACS, so you get those amazing benefits included.
